notes: All coordinates/sizes are in Unreal centimeters (1m = 100). Center = actor location, size = full extents (box width/depth/height), not half-extents. Feel free to hand-tune every value in the editor after the first run - this file only drives the initial greybox pass.

zones.name: Start Plateau
zones.description: Overgrown high ground. Safe start point with a view over the flooded city.

zones.name: Sunken Boulevard
zones.description: Main street, flooded. Water surface at Z=0, road bed below.

zones.name: The Cathedral
zones.description: Main exploration landmark: collapsed roof, flooded ground floor, light shafts.

zones.name: Underwater Passage
zones.description: Fully submerged shortcut connecting the boulevard to the semi-basement.

zones.name: Semi-Basement
zones.description: Small flooded room reached via the underwater passage. Water drains here when the puzzle is solved.

zones.name: Bell Tower Viewpoint
zones.description: Final landmark. Climbing it reveals the whole prototype area.

discoveries.description: A rusted directional sign, half-swallowed by vines.
A family photo, laminated by decades underwater.
Screen shattered. Still faintly warm from a long-dead battery.
The city's old crest, cast in green-stained bronze.
A few words, barely legible, folded into a pipe joint.
Faded lettering for a shop that sold something, once.
A small key on a ribbon, tied to the tower railing.
